items.title: The Blind Weigher
items.question: Blindfolded I weigh every soul alike, yet my sword never sleeps. Courts carve me over doors I never enter. What am I?
items.hintText:
Courts carve me above their doors.
My blindfold promises impartial weight.
Swords in my hand never sleep.
items.correctExplanation: Justice — blind weighing plus unsleeping sword plus courthouse carvings. Emblems assemble the abstraction.
items.incorrectExplanation: Not quite — the answer is justice. The blindfold (impartiality), scales (weighing souls), and sword (enforcement) are her classical attributes; carved doors confirm the civic reading.
items.lessonContent:
Emblems assemble abstractions piece by piece.
Blindfolds promise impartiality everywhere.
Civic carvings confirm institutional readings.
Attributes plus habitat name the concept.
Share this: weigh one dispute blindfolded.

items.title: The Unheld Bird
items.question: Cage me and I die; release me and I stay. Prisoners dream me while tyrants fear my name. What am I?
items.hintText:
Cages kill me; open skies keep me.
Prisoners dream me nightly.
Tyrants fear my very name.
items.correctExplanation: Freedom — dying in cages, staying when released, dreamed by prisoners. The bird that perishes when held.
items.incorrectExplanation: Actually, the answer is freedom. Cage-kills plus release-stays isolates what exists only unheld; prisoner-dreams and tyrant-fears confirm the political reading.
items.lessonContent:
Die-when-held marks unownable goods.
Dreamers and fearers triangulate abstractions.
Release-stays inverts possession logic.
Name what perishes under grip.
Share this: release one held thing today.

items.title: The Naked Runner
items.question: Clothed in proof I slow to a walk; naked I outrun every lie. Courts demand me but rarely host me. What am I?
items.hintText:
Lies never outrun me in the end.
Proof clothes me but slows my pace.
Courts demand what they rarely host.
items.correctExplanation: Truth — outrunning lies, slowed by proof's clothing, demanded yet absent in courts. Nakedness is speed here.
items.incorrectExplanation: Not quite — the answer is truth. Lie-outrunning plus proof-clothing plus court-demanding assembles the concept: reality unadorned travels fastest. Nakedness means unmediated, not undressed.
items.lessonContent:
Unadorned travels fastest always.
Proof clothes but also slows.
Demand-plus-absence marks institutions' ideals.
Nakedness means unmediated here.
Share this: run one naked fact today.

items.title: The Unpaid Debt
items.question: I grow every heart I touch yet vanish the moment I'm counted. Lovers trade me daily and never go broke. What am I?
items.hintText:
Counting me makes me vanish.
Sweethearts trade me without going broke.
Touched hearts grow larger, not smaller.
items.correctExplanation: Love — growing by touch, dying by counting, traded without depletion. Anti-economics of the heart.
items.incorrectExplanation: Actually, the answer is love. Grow-by-touch plus vanish-when-counted plus trade-without-broke isolates the non-rival good of hearts. Lovers' commerce follows anti-economics.
items.lessonContent:
Non-rival goods multiply in transit.
Counting kills what touching grows.
Lovers' commerce defies accounting.
Trade-without-depletion marks heart goods.
Share this: trade one uncounted gift.

items.title: The Hungry Throne
items.question: I corrupt the holder who never questions me and abandon the seeker who chases me directly. Thrones display me; graves keep me. What am I?
items.hintText:
Thrones display me; graves keep me.
Unquestioned holding corrupts holders.
Direct chasers watch me flee.
items.correctExplanation: Power — corrupting unquestioned holders, fleeing direct chasers, kept by graves. Thrones and tombs frame it.
items.incorrectExplanation: Not quite — the answer is power. Corrupt-without-questioning plus flee-when-chased plus throne-and-grave habitat assembles authority's paradox. Seeking sideways (through service) is the only grip.
items.lessonContent:
Unquestioned holding corrupts all holders.
Direct chase repels its quarry reliably.
Thrones display; graves retain: the full arc.
Sideways seeking grips what frontal fails.
Share this: question one held sway kindly.

items.title: The Fed Flame
items.question: Prisoners keep me on bread and water; tyrants cannot confiscate me. I shrink every fear I touch. What am I?
items.hintText:
Bread and water sustain me in cells.
No tyrant has ever confiscated me.
Touched fears shrink; unfed ones grow.
items.correctExplanation: Hope — prison-proof, unconfiscatable, fear-shrinking. The last possession and first resistance.
items.incorrectExplanation: Actually, the answer is hope. Kept-on-nothing plus unconfiscatable plus fear-shrinking isolates expectation's stubborn flame. Cells hold bodies; they never hold horizons.
items.lessonContent:
Unconfiscatable goods resist all tyrants.
Kept-on-nothing marks inner resources.
Fear shrinks where expectation burns.
Horizons survive every cell built.
Share this: feed one flame today.

items.title: The Borrowed Coat
items.question: I fit giants and children from one wardrobe; cowards wear me daily while heroes feel naked without me. What am I?
items.hintText:
Giants and children share my wardrobe.
Cowards wear me; heroes miss me.
Courage needs me as raw material.
items.correctExplanation: Fear — universal wardrobe, cowards' uniform, heroes' raw material. Courage is tailored fear, not its absence.
items.incorrectExplanation: Not quite — the answer is fear. One-size-fits-all plus daily-wear plus heroes'-material assembles the universal coat. Naked-without-it inverts the usual shame.
items.lessonContent:
Universal wardrobes fit giants and children.
Raw materials differ from finished virtues.
Missing-it marks heroes, not cowards.
Tailored coats beat absent ones.
Share this: tailor one trembling today.

items.title: The Fading Palace
items.question: I build palaces overnight and abandon them by breakfast; poets furnish me while scholars deny my address. What am I?
items.hintText:
Overnight I raise whole palaces.
Breakfast often finds them empty.
Poets furnish what scholars question.
items.correctExplanation: Memory — palace-building overnight, abandoned by morning, furnished by poets. Reconstruction poses as record.
items.incorrectExplanation: Actually, the answer is memory. Build-overnight plus abandon-by-breakfast plus poet-furnished isolates reconstructive recall: each remembering rebuilds, never replays. Palaces, not photographs.
items.lessonContent:
Reconstruction poses as recording daily.
Overnight building marks dream-work and recall.
Poets furnish what scholars audit.
Palaces, never photographs, house pasts.
Share this: tour one fading palace.

items.title: The Slow Fruit
items.question: Schools sell me in certificates but cannot confer me; fools bypass me while scholars chase me for decades. What am I?
items.hintText:
Certificates promise but never confer me.
Fools bypass me entirely.
Decades of chasing barely approach me.
items.correctExplanation: Wisdom — uncertifiable, unchasable directly, ripening over decades. Slow fruit of lived seasons.
items.incorrectExplanation: Not quite — the answer is wisdom. Sold-in-certificates yet never-conferred plus chased-for-decades isolates the slow fruit: knowledge hurries, wisdom ripens. Fools bypass what scholars pursue.
items.lessonContent:
Slow fruits ripen beyond chasing.
Certificates promise what decades deliver.
Knowledge hurries; ripening takes decades.
Bypassed-by-fools marks real quarry.
Share this: ripen one judgment slowly.

items.title: The Night Cinema
items.question: I screen epics nightly to an audience of one who never buys tickets and rarely remembers the show. What am I?
items.hintText:
Nightly I screen epics free.
My audience never buys tickets.
Mornings erase most showings.
items.correctExplanation: Dream — nightly epics for one sleeper, ticketless and mostly forgotten. Cinema of the closed eye.
items.incorrectExplanation: Actually, the answer is dream. Screen-nightly plus audience-of-one plus rarely-remembered isolates sleep cinema: production without admission, shows without reviews. Forgetting is the house policy.
items.lessonContent:
Ticketless cinemas run nightly everywhere.
Audiences-of-one need no admission.
Forgetting is the house policy here.
Production without reviews defines dreams.
Share this: review one night cinema.

items.title: The Weightless Seed
items.question: I weigh nothing yet topple empires; planted in one mind I colonize millions. Censors burn books to kill me. What am I?
items.hintText:
Weightless, yet I topple thrones.
One mind plants me; millions host me.
Censors burn libraries against me.
items.correctExplanation: Idea — weightless empire-toppler, colonizing minds, feared by censors. Seeds outlast bonfires.
items.incorrectExplanation: Not quite — the answer is idea. Weigh-nothing plus topple-empires plus censor-feared isolates mind-seeds: planted once, hosted by millions. Bonfires prove the terror, never the cure.
items.lessonContent:
Weightless seeds topple weighted thrones.
Censor-fear measures seed power exactly.
Bonfires prove terror, never cures.
One planting colonizes millions.
Share this: plant one weightless seed.

items.title: The Kept Whisper
items.question: Told to one I live; told to all I die. Gossips trade me; vaults envy my security. What am I?
items.hintText:
One keeper sustains me; crowds kill me.
Gossips trade my currency daily.
Vaults envy my best security.
items.correctExplanation: Secret — living by concealment, dying by broadcast. Audience size is lethality here.
items.incorrectExplanation: Actually, the answer is secret. Told-to-one-lives plus told-to-all-dies isolates concealed knowledge: each new keeper halves the lifespan. Gossip is the marketplace; silence the vault.
items.lessonContent:
Audience size equals lethality here.
Concealment is life; broadcast is death.
Keepers halve lifespans by sharing.
Silence vaults what gossip markets.
Share this: keep one whisper alive.

items.title: The Painted Mask
items.question: I dress as fact for every occasion yet dissolve under direct questioning. Flatterers feed me; mirrors starve me. What am I?
items.hintText:
I costume as fact for all occasions.
Direct questions dissolve me.
Flatterers feed me daily.
items.correctExplanation: Deceit — costumed fact dissolving under questions, fed by flattery, starved by mirrors. Wardrobe, not substance.
items.incorrectExplanation: Not quite — the answer is deceit. Dress-as-fact plus dissolve-under-questioning plus flatterer-fed isolates falsehood: costume departments, not tailors, supply it. Mirrors (honest reflection) are famine.
items.lessonContent:
Costumes pose as substance daily.
Questions dissolve what flattery feeds.
Mirrors famine falsehoods reliably.
Wardrobe, never tailoring, supplies masks.
Share this: mirror one costume today.

items.title: The Final Teacher
items.question: Kings and beggars attend my school without tuition; graduates never return to describe the lessons. What am I?
items.hintText:
Kings and beggars share my classroom.
No tuition is ever charged.
Graduates never report back.
items.correctExplanation: Death — universal school, free tuition, silent alumni. The final teacher keeps all transcripts sealed.
items.incorrectExplanation: Actually, the answer is death. Attend-without-tuition plus never-returning graduates isolates mortality: democracy of attendance, secrecy of curriculum. Teachers who never release reviews.
items.lessonContent:
Silent alumni mark ultimate schools.
Tuition-free attendance means everyone enrolls.
Democracy of entry, secrecy of lessons.
Sealed transcripts define final teachers.
Share this: audit one lesson early.

items.title: The First Cry
items.question: I announce arrivals with noise and depart life in silence; every biography opens with me. What am I?
items.hintText:
Noise announces my arrival always.
Silence marks my counterpart, not me.
Every biography opens with me.
items.correctExplanation: Birth — noisy arrival opening every life story. Biographies begin where silence ends.
items.incorrectExplanation: Not quite — the answer is birth. Announce-with-noise plus open-every-biography isolates natality: life's loud overture. Counterpart-silence (death) frames by contrast.
items.lessonContent:
Overtures announce louder than finales.
Biographies open where silence breaks.
Arrivals make noise; departures keep quiet.
First cries found all narratives.
Share this: celebrate one loud arrival.

items.title: The Leaden Cloak
items.question: I rustle behind every bleak diagnosis and sit beside every fresh grave; fought, I shrink; fed, I swallow mourners whole. What am I?
items.hintText:
Diagnoses summon me bedside.
Graves keep my quiet company.
Fought, I shrink; fed, I swallow.
items.correctExplanation: Despair — bedside at diagnoses, graveside at burials, shrinking when fought. Hope's photographic negative.
items.incorrectExplanation: Not quite — the answer is despair. Summoned-by-diagnosis plus grave-company plus shrink-when-fought isolates hopelessness: fought it contracts, fed it devours. Resistance is the whole treatment.
items.lessonContent:
Bedside summons mark bleak visitors.
Grave-company keeps the darkest hours.
Fought-shrinks while fed-devours: the rule.
Resistance is the entire treatment.
Share this: fight one bleak visitor today.

items.title: The Quiet Oar
items.question: I row boats no engine moves; masters spend decades carving me from impatience. What am I?
items.hintText:
Engines cannot move my boats.
Decades carve me from raw haste.
Masters wield me silently.
items.correctExplanation: Patience — engineless rowing, decades-carved, silently wielded. Time becomes oar in practiced hands.
items.incorrectExplanation: Not quite — the answer is patience. Row-without-engine plus carve-from-impatience plus silent-masters isolates endurance perfected: waiting weaponized. Impatience is the raw log; masters carve oars.
items.lessonContent:
Waiting weaponized moves engineless boats.
Raw impatience carves into oars slowly.
Silent wielding beats loud striving.
Time becomes tool in practiced hands.
Share this: row one boat enginelessly.

items.title: The Scared Muscle
items.question: I grow only when exercised against resistance, and danger is my gymnasium. Cowards shrink me; the brave feed me daily. What am I?
items.hintText:
Resistance alone grows me.
Danger is my gymnasium.
Daily feeding keeps me fit.
items.correctExplanation: Courage — muscle grown by resistance, fed in danger, shrunk by avoidance. Exercise, not absence of fear.
items.incorrectExplanation: Actually, the answer is courage. Grow-by-resistance plus danger-gymnasium plus daily-feeding isolates the exercised virtue: fear faced repeatedly becomes strength. Muscles, moral and otherwise, need loads.
items.lessonContent:
Virtues need loads like muscles do.
Danger gymnasiums build moral muscle.
Daily feeding prevents all atrophy.
Faced fear becomes strength steadily.
Share this: lift one fear today.

items.title: The Open Hand
items.question: I release debts no court can collect and free prisoners no jailer holds. The wronged hoard me; the wise spend me. What am I?
items.hintText:
Courts cannot collect my debts.
Jailers hold none of my prisoners.
The wronged hoard me; the wise spend me.
items.correctExplanation: Mercy — releasing uncollectible debts, freeing unheld prisoners. Spending heals the spender first.
items.incorrectExplanation: Not quite — the answer is mercy. Release-without-jurisdiction plus hoard-versus-spend isolates clemency: courts lack standing, jailers lack inmates. The wise spend what the wronged stockpile.
items.lessonContent:
Uncollectible debts release freely.
Spending heals spenders before debtors.
Courts lack standing over clemency.
Hoarded clemency helps no one.
Share this: spend one pardon today.

items.title: The Unchained Past
items.question: I unlock cells whose doors rotted decades ago; no key exists yet every prisoner holds one. What am I?
items.hintText:
Rotted doors still need my key.
No metal key exists for me.
Every prisoner already holds one.
items.correctExplanation: Forgiveness — unlocking rotted cells with keyless keys every prisoner holds. Freedom predates the door's decay.
items.incorrectExplanation: Actually, the answer is forgiveness. Unlock-rotted-cells plus no-metal-key plus every-prisoner-holds isolates pardon: the lock is internal, so the key must be too. Decades rot doors; only pardon opens histories.
items.lessonContent:
Internal locks need internal keys.
Rotted doors still bar unpardoned pasts.
Every prisoner holds the only key.
Histories open from inside alone.
Share this: turn one inner key.

items.title: The Hungry Eye
items.question: I eat answers and grow hungrier; children wear me openly while experts hide me. What am I?
items.hintText:
Answers feed but never fill me.
Children display me openly.
Experts conceal me carefully.
items.correctExplanation: Curiosity — hungrier per answer, open in children, hidden in experts. Appetite that eating whets.
items.incorrectExplanation: Not quite — the answer is curiosity. Eat-answers-grow-hungrier plus children-open-experts-hidden isolates inquiry's appetite: feeding stimulates rather than satiates. Hidden hunger still starves minds.
items.lessonContent:
Answer-eating whets inquiry's appetite.
Open display beats concealed hunger.
Experts hide what children flaunt.
Feeding stimulates; never satiates.
Share this: flaunt one hunger openly.

items.title: The Honest Fog
items.question: I cloud every certainty yet sharpen every inquiry; dogmatists banish me while scientists keep me as counsel. What am I?
items.hintText:
Certainties fog where I gather.
Inquiries sharpen under my counsel.
Dogmatists banish me outright.
items.correctExplanation: Doubt — fogging certainty, sharpening inquiry, banished by dogma, counseled by science. Honest weather of minds.
items.incorrectExplanation: Actually, the answer is doubt. Cloud-certainty plus sharpen-inquiry plus dogmatist-banished isolates productive skepticism: fog that reveals by obscuring. Counsel kept, never worshipped.
items.lessonContent:
Fog reveals by obscuring reliably.
Counsel questions; never worship them.
Banished-by-dogma marks honest weather.
Certainties need regular fogging.
Share this: fog one certainty today.

items.title: The Blind Leap
items.question: I build bridges over evidence gaps that reason cannot cross; martyrs die for me while cynics call me blindness. What am I?
items.hintText:
Evidence gaps need my bridges.
Martyrs die testifying for me.
Cynics diagnose me as blindness.
items.correctExplanation: Faith — bridging evidence gaps, martyr-witnessed, cynic-dismissed. Leaps land beyond reason's edge.
items.incorrectExplanation: Not quite — the answer is faith. Bridge-evidence-gaps plus martyr-testified plus cynic-dismissed isolates trust beyond proof: leaps reason maps but cannot make. Blindness to some is vision past sight.
items.lessonContent:
Leaps land past reason's mapped edge.
Bridges span what evidence cannot.
Martyrs testify where proofs fall short.
Vision past sight looks blind up close.
Share this: leap one small gap.

items.title: The Prepared Accident
items.question: I favor no one yet visit the ready most; gamblers worship me while statisticians dissolve me into rates. What am I?
items.hintText:
I play favorites with the prepared.
Gamblers build altars to me.
Statisticians melt me into rates.
items.correctExplanation: Luck — favoring the ready, worshipped by gamblers, dissolved by statistics. Prepared accidents keep happening.
items.incorrectExplanation: Actually, the answer is luck. Favor-ready plus gambler-worshipped plus statistician-dissolved isolates chance: accidents that preparation harvests. Rates explain populations; persons experience visits.
items.lessonContent:
Preparation harvests accidents reliably.
Altars rise where rates suffice.
Populations average; persons get visited.
Ready fields catch falling chances.
Share this: prepare one accident today.

items.title: The Written Script
items.question: Prophets claim to read me, yet my pages turn only forward; fatalists submit while rebels edit margins. What am I?
items.hintText:
Prophets claim my pages daily.
Forward alone do my leaves turn.
Rebels annotate my margins.
items.correctExplanation: Fate — prophet-read, forward-turning, margin-annotated by rebels. Scripts read differently by submitters and editors.
items.incorrectExplanation: Not quite — the answer is fate. Read-by-prophets plus forward-only plus rebel-annotated isolates destiny: submitted to by fatalists, edited by rebels. Margins hold more freedom than pages.
items.lessonContent:
Margins hold more freedom than pages.
Forward-only turning limits all readers.
Submitters differ from editors entirely.
Annotate scripts you cannot rewrite.
Share this: edit one margin today.
